title: Sparks / GPU and host health
description: GPU, heat, memory and interconnect health for the Spark machines, so a slow or failing model can be traced to its cause. Shared CPU/GPU memory usage is host memory usage, not GPU allocation.

panels.title: GPU use
panels.description: GPU busy fraction averaged over each step. It reads high whenever a job is loaded, so read it beside clock speed and power.

panels.title: GPU clock
panels.description: Average shader clock over each step against the device's maximum. A clock far under its usual level with no slowdown reported is worth a look.

panels.title: GPU power
panels.description: Highest GPU draw in each step. This is the GPU alone; the CPU, network card and drive are not included.

panels.title: Time slowed
panels.description: Share of each step the driver held the clock back. A power cap is ordinary operation; hardware thermal slowdown is not.

panels.title: Board temperature
panels.description: Hottest of the machine's ACPI thermal zones in each step. The firmware's critical trip point is 104.8 °C, drawn in red. It usually runs hotter than the GPU.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: Highest GPU temperature in each step.

panels.title: Room to the limit
panels.description: Degrees left before each limit, lowest in each step: the GPU's own slowdown limit, and the board's critical trip point.

panels.title: GPU thermal throttling
panels.description: Thermal slowdown flag per machine. A value of one for five minutes matches the thermal-throttling alert.

panels.title: NVMe temperature
panels.description: Composite NVMe temperature per device. The 77.85 °C line, 5 °C under the drive's own 82.85 °C warning temperature, matches the hot-NVMe alert after five minutes.

panels.title: ConnectX temperature
panels.description: Network adapter temperature. Tensor-parallel work adds RDMA load to a card that already runs warm.

panels.title: Memory available
panels.description: Memory left. CPU and GPU share one pool, so a loaded model keeps this low by design; the GPU exporter reports no separate GPU memory.

panels.title: Host memory stalls
panels.description: Fraction of time stalled on memory over five minutes. The 10% line matches the memory-stall alert after 15 minutes.

panels.title: Disk space used
panels.description: Used fraction of each persistent local filesystem. The 90% line matches the low-space alert after 30 minutes.

panels.title: RoCE traffic
panels.description: Data over the adapter ports that link the two Sparks, per second. The second port pair carries none.

panels.title: RoCE errors
panels.description: Link-downs, acknowledgement timeouts, sequence errors, receive errors and retransmits on those ports in each step. Anything above zero slows or stalls tensor-parallel work.
